research_findings: Analyzed standard warnings during Vitest runs in the UI codebase.
Identified un-wrapped `act()` calls in `DiagramCanvas.test.tsx` leading to React warnings.
Identified accessibility warnings in `FeedbackModal` components regarding missing `DialogDescription`.
Identified intentional errors logged by test files testing error scenarios, polluting the test output.
features_improved: Wrapped `vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync` with `act()` in `DiagramCanvas.test.tsx` to fix React state update test warnings.
Added visually hidden `<DialogDescription>` to `FeedbackModal.tsx` directly inside `<DialogHeader>` to resolve Radix UI missing description accessibility warnings.

Mocked `console.error` in error scenario tests for `admin.test.ts`, `problem-intro-resolver.test.ts`, `langgraph-interview-summary.test.ts`, and `session-storage.test.ts` to silence intentional console errors during successful test runs.
next_steps_for_next_run: Continue monitoring test outputs and resolve remaining noisy logs or test coverage gaps.
